propositions: The grounding harness hard-codes fork context which emits a DeprecationWarning in CPython 3.12 when a background thread exists, creating deadlock risk in multithreaded hosts.
Worker callables must be importable module-level names with pickleable arguments, return values, and any attached state, incompatible with closures and lambdas under spawn.
Process construction, serialization, and result unpickling failures must return a fail-open RunResult with abstain_reason instead of propagating exceptions.
The public run_in_worker callable must default to spawn context for thread-safety while accepting an optional caller-supplied context for explicit fork compatibility.
Spawn-incompatible test fixtures that attach unpicklable local closures to Process objects require replacement with parent-only proxies.
Documentation must specify the importability/pickleability contract and document the explicit fork escape hatch for legacy callers.
